links.outcome: Whether each cited claim in generated notes points to a real transcript line
links.effect: 301 of 302 citations pointed to real transcript lines; the one uncited claim was flagged for manual checking. This was an existence check only; faithfulness was not measured.
links.quote: In generated notes, 301 of 302 citations pointed to real transcript lines — an existence check, with clinical faithfulness unmeasured pending independent rating; the one uncited claim was flagged for manual checking.

links.outcome: Urgency alarm firing in scripted emergencies versus routine consultations
links.effect: Alarm fired in all 8 scripted emergencies and stayed silent in 6 of 7 routine consultations (1 unnecessary alarm).
links.quote: The urgency alarm fired in all eight scripted emergencies and stayed silent in six of seven routine consultations.

links.outcome: Defects found in acted consultations in a real room that automated checks missed
links.effect: Five acted consultations surfaced five defects the automated checks had missed, four of them serious; all were fixed and each pinned by a regression test.
